tasks.short: Establish functional machinery and service equipment arrangements aboard vessels.

steps.what: Establish candidate arrangements for boiler room, propulsion, ventilation, refrigeration, piping and functional equipment
inputs: actual vessel envelope and equipment specifications
actual approved functional and clearance requirements
outputs: actual candidate equipment arrangement and fixed check criteria

steps.what: Check fixed geometric clashes and specified clearances in the candidate machinery arrangement
inputs: actual candidate equipment arrangement and fixed check criteria
outputs: source-linked geometric clash and clearance results

steps.what: Assess actual arrangement tradeoffs and resolve geometric, serviceability and functional issues
inputs: source-linked geometric clash and clearance results
actual candidate equipment arrangement and fixed check criteria
outputs: chosen actual equipment arrangement and unresolved constraints

steps.what: Complete and check actual arrangement drawings and retain final internal engineering records
inputs: chosen actual equipment arrangement and unresolved constraints
actual vessel/equipment requirements
outputs: checked saved final internal equipment arrangement drawings

tasks.design: Configure fixed geometric clash/clearance checks in the marine CAD {OTHER} after the engineer creates the candidate arrangement. Retain functional layout choices, serviceability judgement, issue resolution and complete drawings/checks in {OTHER}/{DOCS}; no automatic safe-arrangement decision or ordinary-save saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed geometric comparisons may be performed manually around a proposed arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geometry checks can apply explicit distances and envelopes.
tasks.still_hard: Maintenance access, functional interaction and real vessel constraints need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects a clash-free arrangement that cannot be maintained aboard ship.
tasks.altitude: Less fixed geometry checking; arrangement decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD geometry checks can apply explicit clash/clearance criteria while marine arrangement suitability remains engineering work.

assumptions: Provisional case requires actual manual fixed geometric comparisons20 today; existing CAD checks/runtime earn zero new saving. {OTHER} is the marine CAD system, not a new autonomous layout designer. Only fully specified geometry/rule checks use s2.

Vessel/equipment owners supply actual model/revision, coordinates/units, envelopes and approved clearance criteria; engineer creates candidate geometry and selects criteria in s1. Missing geometry or ambiguous requirements remain manual. Full issue interpretation20 and actual final drawing work15 stay. Ordinary internal saves are included unchanged without self-approval; actual construction release must use its real separate review/action if assigned.
unknowns: Which clearance checks are already native and which criteria can be encoded?
research_questions: Can native results reproduce hand-checked clashes without implying functional approval?

incremental.description: Maintain explicit clearance criteria, model compatibility and exception checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 actual manual fixed-geometry check points minus1 upkeep=19. Low: a complex machinery room has mostly unencoded service/access constraints, leaving only5 explicit geometric-check points removable, minus1=4. Candidate design, suitability judgement, resolution and complete drawings retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate and observe machinery tests for standards compliance.

steps.what: Choose applicable standards, test questions and actual machinery investigation requirements
inputs: actual machinery and test scope
actual current standards and equipment requirements
outputs: chosen test/investigation criteria and source references

steps.what: Prepare and check selected test checklist headings and requirement references
inputs: chosen test/investigation criteria and source references
actual current selected test sections
outputs: checked saved actual test observation checklist

steps.what: Investigate and observe actual machinery and equipment tests and capture compliance evidence
inputs: checked saved actual test observation checklist
actual tests, instrument readings and equipment behaviour
outputs: actual witnessed test observations, readings and exceptions

steps.what: Assess compliance and write/check actual investigation findings and limitations
inputs: actual witnessed test observations, readings and exceptions
chosen test/investigation criteria and source references
outputs: checked saved actual machinery test assessment

tasks.design: Configure reuse of selected checklist headings and current requirement references in {DOCS}/test-record {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain criteria selection, complete checklist checking, actual witnessed tests and the full written compliance assessment; neither test runtime nor ordinary internal saves earn saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable test observation sections may be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native selected-section reuse can remove preparation without judging compliance.
tasks.still_hard: Real behaviour, abnormal tests and evidential limits require an engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer notices that a nominal test pass omitted an important operating condition.
tasks.altitude: Less checklist preparation; test witnessing and compliance judgement stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected test-checklist reuse can reduce preparation while actual test observation and compliance assessment remain engineering work.

assumptions: Provisional preparation15 removes three repeated heading/reference assembly points; twelve actual adaptation/check points remain. Existing templates earn zero new credit. Actual observation/capture60 and complete written assessment10 stay.

Equipment/standards owners supply actual id/revision, test criterion, unit and applicability; engineer chooses these in s1. Missing requirements are clarified manually. Real measurements come from actual instruments and witnessed tests, with no invented structured feed. Internal saves are retained and ungated; any actual formal certificate/release must be separately mapped if owned here.
unknowns: Which checklist sections are already reusable and current?
research_questions: Can reused sections preserve equipment-specific test conditions and evidence requirements?

incremental.description: Maintain selected test headings and current requirement references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated checklist-assembly points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: a novel machinery test needs new conditions and sections, leaving only1 stable requirement-reference point removable, minus0.4=0.6. Criteria choice, real observation/capture and complete assessment retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare marine plans, estimates, construction schedules and contract specifications.

steps.what: Choose actual marine design plan, construction scope and special contract provisions
inputs: actual client/vessel requirements
actual design and construction constraints
outputs: chosen plan, construction scope and special provisions

steps.what: Establish and verify actual quantities, cost rates, units and estimate assumptions
inputs: chosen plan, construction scope and special provisions
actual design quantities and current supplier/labour cost evidence
outputs: checked quantity/rate table and estimate rules

steps.what: Calculate actual quantity-times-rate estimates and assemble line-item cost totals
inputs: checked quantity/rate table and estimate rules

steps.what: Determine actual design and construction sequence, dependencies and feasible schedule
inputs: chosen plan, construction scope and special provisions
calculated sourced construction estimate
actual yard/resource constraints

steps.what: Write contract specifications and explanations of the chosen special provisions
inputs: chosen plan, construction scope and special provisions
calculated sourced construction estimate
chosen design/construction schedule and dependencies

loop.purpose: Draft explanations of already chosen scope and special provisions
loop.input: actual chosen plan, verified estimate, schedule and engineer-selected provisions
loop.output: source-linked specification prose without new obligations
loop.check: Engineer checks technical meaning, scope boundaries, omissions, quantities, sequencing and exact obligations against chosen provisions
loop.stop: Unspecified obligation, missing source or two failed revisions returns affected text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native specification sections first; variable special-provision explanations require semantic checking beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Complete and check the whole engineering package and retain its final internal version
inputs: complete sourced plans/estimates/schedule/specification draft package
checked quantity/rate table and estimate rules
chosen plan, construction scope and special provisions
outputs: checked saved final internal plans/estimates/schedule/specification package

tasks.design: Configure native quantity/rate estimate calculations in {SPREADSHEET}, with actual design quantities checked from marine CAD {OTHER}. Draft only explanations of engineer-chosen contract provisions in {DOCS}, retaining plan decisions, feasible scheduling in {PROJECT} and complete final package checks; ordinary internal saving earns no credit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual estimate arithmetic and descriptive specification typing repeat around actual design choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculations and source-constrained prose drafting can remove that preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Scope, uncertainty, construction feasibility and binding provisions require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies a plausible schedule/specification combination that cannot be built safely.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic and descriptive typing; design and contract decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed quantity/rate calculations and constrained drafting can assist estimates/specifications while engineering scope and obligations remain human decisions.

assumptions: Provisional case requires actual manual arithmetic/line-total assembly20, not existing spreadsheet runtime. Already automated totals earn no new credit. Three of15 prose points are descriptive typing removed after retained review; scientific/contract decisions remain.

Actual model/quantity owners supply item id/version, quantity/unit; suppliers and cost owners supply dated rate/currency, basis and exclusions. Engineer verifies/enters these in s2, clarifying missing data manually. Yard/resource owners supply actual constraints, with feasibility chosen in s4. No free quote extraction or uncounted quantity survey.

Boundary is preparation of an internal package, not contract signing, construction authorisation or customer send. Those actual owned actions need separate final-version review/action mapping if present. Ordinary saves remain unchanged and ungated in s6.
unknowns: Which estimate calculations and specification sections are already automated?
research_questions: Can totals reproduce known estimates and prose preserve the exact selected special obligations?

incremental.description: Maintain estimate units/rates schema and special-provision source/meaning checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 manual arithmetic/total assembly plus3 descriptive prose points minus1.3 upkeep=21.7. Low: a novel construction scope needs mostly bespoke cost calculations and fresh provisions; only4 standard line-total points and1 descriptive typing point disappear, minus1.3=3.7. Quantities, design, scheduling and complete final checks retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and oversee marine apparatus testing, installation and repair.

steps.what: Design actual marine apparatus changes and choose testing, installation and repair requirements
inputs: actual apparatus problem and vessel constraints
actual current design and operating evidence
outputs: chosen apparatus design and work/test requirements

steps.what: Prepare and check selected apparatus drawing labels, work instructions and test sections
inputs: chosen apparatus design and work/test requirements
actual current selected drawing/instruction sections
outputs: checked saved actual apparatus work/test instruction package

steps.what: Oversee actual marine apparatus tests and assess observed behaviour and defects
inputs: checked saved actual apparatus work/test instruction package
actual apparatus tests and conditions
outputs: actual test oversight observations and findings

steps.what: Oversee actual apparatus installation and repair and resolve observed engineering issues
inputs: checked saved actual apparatus work/test instruction package
actual installation/repair work and site conditions
outputs: actual installation/repair oversight decisions and observations

steps.what: Write and check actual apparatus work findings and retain assigned engineering records
inputs: actual test oversight observations and findings
actual installation/repair oversight decisions and observations
outputs: checked saved actual marine apparatus engineering record

tasks.design: Configure selected drawing/instruction-section reuse in marine CAD {OTHER} and {DOCS}. Keep actual design choices, device-specific adaptation, complete instruction checks, physical test/installation/repair oversight and full actual findings in maintenance {OPS_SYSTEM}; existing automation and ordinary saves earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable drawing labels and instruction sections may be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-section reuse can remove limited preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Real apparatus and vessel conditions require on-site engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies an installation detail that invalidates the intended test condition.
tasks.altitude: Less instruction assembly; apparatus and site decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native drawing/instruction reuse can reduce preparation while apparatus design and physical work oversight remain engineering work.

assumptions: Provisional preparation20 removes three repeated label/section assembly points; seventeen actual adaptation/check points remain. Existing reuse receives zero credit. Focal oversight is counted, not installation/repair personnel's labour.

Design/method owners supply actual apparatus id, drawing revision, selected instructions and applicability; engineer chooses actual requirements in s1. Missing information is clarified manually. Test and work observations are real, captured during oversight before s5 writing; no completed repair inferred from an instruction. Tests may be scheduled before/after individual repairs according to actual plan, never using future findings as inputs. No new formal release or supplier send is invented.
unknowns: Which instruction sections are stable and already reused?
research_questions: Can reuse preserve apparatus-specific isolation, installation and test conditions?

incremental.description: Maintain selected apparatus instruction/drawing revisions and applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeat instruction/drawing assembly points minus0.4 upkeep=2.6. Low: an unfamiliar apparatus needs fresh drawings and instructions, leaving only1 stable identification/reference section point reusable, minus0.4=0.6. Actual design, complete checks, physical oversight and full findings retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce actual fixed checking/calculation and selected preparation while retaining marine engineering decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable deterministic preparation supports engineers who retain design, construction and vessel judgement.
